answer: Each AI agent must obtain a signed remote‑attestation token from a unique TEE whose hardware ID is hashed into a public ledger entry called a delta record. The token, together with a short gale‑derived nonce, is verified and the ledger requires a yarrow‑seeded bond locked for 48 h. An attacker therefore must purchase a distinct TEE, pay the bond (e.g., 10 tokens per identity), and wait the lock‑time, making each fake identity cost 10 tokens plus hardware expense.
